notes:
Freeform layouts and layers — 0.9.0 Preview

Choose Quilt → Freeform Blocks & Panels to place blocks and fabric panels freely.
Enter exact fractions, drag with snapping, resize, rotate, mirror, duplicate,
align and undo. Saved blocks work in the new layout. Supported arrangements have
real background-panel cuts and a numbered assembly packet.

Design details now includes Quilt top, Surface design and Quilting plan layers.
Draw and edit closed vector motifs with the existing drawing studio; show, hide
and lock layers. Projects save the exact geometry and reopen in this version.

Surface appliqué is a design preview in this release. Cutting and complete-project
yardage are blocked while surface motifs are present. Quilting outlines are
placement guides, not stitch paths. Overlapping or partial-seam freeform layouts
also need adjustment before cutting calculations are available.

Save your work before updating. Existing projects, My Blocks, fabrics and the
appearance default are preserved. Freeform/layer projects need version 0.9.0;
save a copy before converting when an older app still needs the original.

Install over your existing copy, or use Help → Check for Updates → Preview /
Development → Check for updates → Download & install. After restart, choose
Restore design to resume the open quilt. Physical print/sew acceptance remains
separate. Source stays private; this release contains the installer only.
